description: Attach a file to a file input on the page: either one the user stored in Browsentic (fileId, from page.listFiles) or one you captured off another page (downloadId, from page.captureDownload). The second closes the loop — download here, upload there — without the bytes ever passing through you.

content.description: Internal: base64 file bytes. Browsentic fills this in.

downloadId.description: Id of a captured download, taken from page.captureDownload or page.listDownloads.

fileId.description: Id of a stored file, taken from page.listFiles.

mime.description: Internal: file MIME type. Browsentic fills this in.

name.description: Internal: original filename. Browsentic fills this in.

target.description: The file input (<input type="file">) to attach the file to.

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

name: page_attachFile
